title: Claude Now Posts to 10 Social Platforms in One Click
description:
Comment "SMM" and I'll send you the link.

Claude can now publish to every social platform with one command. The tool's called OmniSocials, three-minute setup, ten platforms from chat. Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, all in one window. Tell Claude to draft a week of posts in your style, it tailors each one per platform, schedules everything at 9 a.m. Ten bucks a month.

#ai #ecommerce #claude #socialmedia #aitools
